descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S19 Server refusals and failed or repeated requests (Tim's tests): no badge change, only the caller's own Hospital patient, mark only through assign; a failed assign or delete and a repeated tap never lose or double the text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Assigning does not create tasks, record medication events, or generate a note. Those happen only when the physician opens that patient's Encounter tab and taps Save & Extract. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 7)
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 2; TFA-92583 AC 2)
  • U8 Quick Dictation is Hospital only and is absent in Nursing Home. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 8)
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; … (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 5; TFA-92582 step 5; TFA-92583 AC 4)
  • T2 If more is dictated into a box after it was assigned, only the new words are added when it is assigned again. (TFA-92582 AC 6; TFA-92582 step 7)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Tim's API tests (two physicians, a Nursing Home resident, an anonymous client) and chromium tests with the first assign or delete request failed at the socket

When Place 'New admission from the ED, admitted today, CHF exacerbation.'; target another physician's patient, another physician's box, a resident; try to mark a box through a plain update. Assign while the request fails, then retry; tap the patient it already went to again; delete while the request fails; …

Then Badge stays as the physician set it; another physician's patient or box is refused and nothing moves; a resident cannot be the target; only assign marks a box. Failed assign: 'Couldn't assign the compartment — try again.', box stays unassigned, chart untouched, retry lands once. Same patient again: text on the chart once. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions: encType unchanged (U7 side effect), 'Patient not found' / 'Draft not found' / 'Not authenticated' with charts unchanged (U6: lands only where tapped), validator error for a roundingPatients id (U8), update with assignedPatientId rejected; …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local (other-physician and anonymous cells) / both (resident target, mark only through assign, socket-failure cells); Source: matrix (lane A).
